description: This file is a PHPUnit test case for the PurgeEmployeeDao within the OrangeHRM maintenance plugin. It includes tests for employee data purging capabilities and data extraction methods based on employee numbers.

classes.name: PurgeEmployeeDaoTest
classes.description: A test case class for testing PurgeDao methods related to employee data purging and extraction.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment and populates test data before each test.

methods.name: testIsEmployeePurgeable
methods.description: Tests whether the DAO correctly identifies if an employee is purgeable.

methods.name: testExtractDataFromEmpNumber
methods.description: Tests whether data extraction from employee number returns expected data.
